description: Synthetic sesslint.report.v1 schema parity. Constraints come from the pinned schema. Report JSON bytes come from render_json and from json.dumps of Report.to_dict on the pinned emitters. No session payload is stored.
known_parity_gaps: Schema path resolution and the missing-file loader are not this validator.
The report anti-drift comparison and the json-schema test allowlist asserts are not one accepted instance.
Regular expressions other than the pinned fingerprint pattern are not proven.
CoverageSkip reasons accepted by the Python class and absent from the pinned schema are not emitted: deselected.
The report crate and mcp_server.rs are outside this card and were not modified. This module emits render_json and compact Report.to_dict bytes.
